parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup schedule.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: InstanceClass
parameters.description:
The specifications of the instance. Valid values:

- micro

- small

- medium

- large

- xlarge

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs upgrade-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi01eXXXX --instance-class micro --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs UpgradeBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPlanId dbstooi01eXXXX --InstanceClass micro --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx
